conventions.priority: P0 = blocks the milestone / release; P1 = required for v1; P2 = nice to have
conventions.testing: automated = NUnit tests in tests/Haugbui.Core.Tests (no game required); manual = in-game validation steps in DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md checklist format
conventions.requirements: HB-xxx ids from PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md covered by the ticket
conventions.versioning: Each completed milestone bumps the version: M1 = 0.0.1, M2 = 0.0.2, M3 = 0.0.3, … (HaugbuiVersion in Directory.Build.props and HaugbuiPlugin.PluginVersion), tagged vX.Y.Z on main.
